messages:
jensen_lighthouse: Hey team — after the canary deploy yesterday our customers (Lighthouse) are seeing a clear drop in grounding/citation coverage from the search+rerank flow. Top-3 results often have 0 valid citations now, or cite unrelated docs. Example query_id=q-9f2a. Request id=req_0a1b2c3d.

anya_cs: Hi Jensen — thanks for flagging. Can you paste a sample user query + the exact response you got (we'll need the request_id which you already gave). Also which rollout were you on (canary vs control)?

jensen_lighthouse: query: "How to integrate the Lighthouse SDK with Stripe for recurring billing?"
response (truncated):
```
We recommend using the OceanPay adapter. See docs: https://oceanpay.example/docs/payments.
Sources: none attached.
```
This used to return three product docs and inline citations. Happened for ~30% of user searches after 2026-03-15 ~16:10 UTC.

raj_sre: Creating incident record. Any API 5xxs or latency spikes reported? Also, what's the model / reranker version shown in client response metadata?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started by tim_eng at 2026-03-15T16:08:47Z. rollout_id=r-26103-canary. Components: retriever-v3 (sha: f4d2e7), reranker-v2-quant (sha: b7c9a1).

marta_ml: Tagging in. Quick hypothesis: the reranker scoring normalization change in this rollout may have lowered scores for anchors, pushing unrelated docs up. Jensen — could you share the top-5 doc IDs returned by the retriever for q-9f2a and the similarity scores (if available)? Even a screenshot is fine.

jensen_lighthouse: Top-5 doc ids in order: doc_443, doc_112, doc_909, doc_77, doc_301. Retriever sims reported in client debug: [0.72, 0.65, 0.61, 0.59, 0.57]. But reranker final ranks place doc_301 and doc_77 above doc_443 and no inline citations were produced.

marta_ml: That aligns with a known side-effect of the new L2-normalize-before-dot change we pushed to reranker-v2-quant. It rescales scores and our thresholding for citation emission didn't migrate. We're going to run a side-by-side compare (reranker-v2-quant vs reranker-v1) using the same retriever outputs.

tim_eng: Confirmed — there was an intentional switch: normalization added to reduce variance across devices. We included it but forgot to update the "citation_emit_threshold" in the rollout config. Rolling back the normalization on canary while we validate.

anya_cs: Jensen — we'll keep you updated. For repro, can you run this curl (replace request_id) so we can capture logs on our side?
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query": "How to integrate the Lighthouse SDK with Stripe for recurring billing?", "top_k": 5, "reranker": "reranker-v2-quant"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/search
```

raj_sre: Internal ticket CS-2321 created and linked to incident INC-2026-45. Oncall assigned: @marta_ml, @tim_eng. Preliminary impact: ~12% of searches with user-visible citation loss in Lighthouse prod canary cohort; recall(top-3) dropped from ~0.87 to ~0.62 in our sampled telemetry.

marta_ml: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert normalization on canary, 2) run A/B on sample queries comparing emitted citations, 3) adjust citation_emit_threshold and add a guard to preserve anchors when retriever sim >0.6. I'll post diffs once tests run.

jensen_lighthouse: Appreciate the quick triage. We're blocking some customer-facing docs release until this is resolved. Please ping once the canary is reverted so we can validate.

anya_cs: Will do. Also please add any additional failing request_ids to the ticket. We'll prioritize rollback if we see further regressions. :thumbsup:

tim_eng: Revert pushed to canary (r-26103-canary) at 2026-03-15T17:02:13Z. Deploy logs: `reranker-v2-quant` -> temporary flag disable normalization. Monitoring metrics now.

deploy-bot: Canary update: rollback-flag applied by tim_eng. New rollout snapshot r-26103-canary-rollback.

marta_ml: Early telemetry after rollback (5m window): top-3 citation coverage in canary cohort recovered from 0.63 -> 0.85. Continue monitoring for 30m then we'll promote safe config.

jensen_lighthouse: Verified on our side — citations look restored for the sample queries I sent. Thanks everyone.

anya_cs: Closing loop here but keeping CS-2321 open until final postmortem and config guard added.

raj_sre: Postmortem requested: include what changed, why threshold mismatch occurred, and a checklist for config migration on reranker changes. Assigned to @tim_eng and @marta_ml.
